title: Day 1 Forecast Discussion
discussion:
Moderate to stronger thunderstorms are expected today

---Discussion---

Thunderstorm activity in the Czech Republic has already started. with the CAPE available and humidity the storms can be long-lived.

The main events will happen after 14:00 until midnight.

It will start in the Czech Republic and will be headed to Poland through Slovakia.

Storms may bring heavy rain, frequent lightning and big hail
